scope: Single-assistant ordinal still-image assessment of all225 native Q11B frames and the retained62 WL4 gameplay references. Six cutscene/UI references remain separate. Not a human panel or an animation-feel certificate.
scale: 0 missing/broken;1 placeholder;2 crude;3 coherent development art;4 polished professional example;5 exceptional authored example. Half-point increments; a tie is not superiority.

rows.title: Sunday Best
rows.strength: The welcoming facades, actor silhouette and readable contact edges work together.
rows.remaining_deficit: Repeated wall modules and the sparse upper silhouettes remain less individually authored than the benchmark.

rows.title: Belfry of Late Voices
rows.strength: Bells, supports and distinct actor poses remain visible through the course.
rows.remaining_deficit: Repetitive platform construction and diagram-like machinery still weaken the room composition.

rows.title: The Puppet Laundry
rows.strength: The wringers, baskets and state-driven actors form a coherent mechanical vocabulary.
rows.remaining_deficit: Long swings still expose empty stretches; the concept has much richer authored machinery.

rows.title: House of Borrowed Skins
rows.strength: Hanging skins and repeated supports make the transformation theme legible.
rows.remaining_deficit: Repetition and crowded object labels compete with gameplay silhouettes.

rows.title: The Kindly Usher
rows.strength: The Usher now has an asymmetric face, sleeve gestures and a weighted coat rather than a largely static mask.
rows.remaining_deficit: Sparse boss-room rhythm and occasional framing cuts remain; this is not benchmark-quality animation approval.

rows.title: Pear Tree Gallows
rows.strength: Fruit cages, rooted materials and the revised orchard patrol read as one setting.
rows.remaining_deficit: The same cage and tree motifs repeat; highlights and foliage depth are less deliberately placed than WL4.

rows.title: Kitchen of the Unfinished Feast
rows.strength: The separate furnace masonry, cauldrons and actor states retain their material distinction.
rows.remaining_deficit: Repetitive fire icons and wall bays still substitute for varied kitchen apparatus.

rows.title: The Saint's Irrigation Ditch
rows.strength: Root faces, water and patrol silhouettes remain coherent in unseen support views.
rows.remaining_deficit: Water and soil share too much midtone in some areas; the environment could explain its construction more strongly.

rows.title: The Garden of No Seasons
rows.strength: Seasonal foliage and rooted supporting surfaces distinguish the garden from the interior levels.
rows.remaining_deficit: Foliage clustering and foreground variation still lag the reference.

rows.title: The Orchard Judge
rows.strength: The Judge has crown, scales, layered regalia and distinct facial reactions.
rows.remaining_deficit: The fixed framing can crop the head; limbs and regalia are still less expressive than the best reference poses.

rows.title: Tenement of Two Suns
rows.strength: The player and mirror relationship remain readable amid apartment motifs.
rows.remaining_deficit: Identical furnishings and panel bays remain visibly procedural; mirror scenes need more authored spatial hierarchy.

rows.title: The Street Behind the Wall
rows.strength: The contour and interior forms retain a clear silhouette against the blue stone.
rows.remaining_deficit: The empty vertical pockets and repeated frames remain weaker than a purpose-composed room.

rows.title: The Perspective Tax Office
rows.strength: Books, counters and the new metal-mask patrol belong to a consistent visual language.
rows.remaining_deficit: The long bookshelf texture and repetitive shelves read as tiling more than an inhabited office.

rows.title: The Hotel That Is Its Own Courtyard
rows.strength: Repeated views keep the indoor traversal surfaces and form silhouettes legible.
rows.remaining_deficit: The hotel still needs stronger room identity and furniture variety; additional texture alone is not enough.

rows.title: The Surveyor
rows.strength: Angular face planes and measuring limbs give the Surveyor a more distinct identity.
rows.remaining_deficit: The horizontal arena furniture is highly repetitive and the sampled camera often follows the player away from the boss.

rows.title: Rain of Kneeling Men
rows.strength: Falling supports and warning regions remain clear in the returned and unseen samples.
rows.remaining_deficit: The warning phase is visually sparse; actual-action sequences are necessary to judge the falling ecology.

rows.title: The Seamstress Bridge
rows.strength: The stitching and moving bridge construction retain dimension and visible edges.
rows.remaining_deficit: Repeating open bays and oversized labels compete with the seam relationships.

rows.title: Procession of Closed Lids
rows.strength: Coffins and turning structures read as physical objects rather than anonymous blocks.
rows.remaining_deficit: Similar shapes repeat too evenly; the processional rhythm and weight still need more individual staging.

rows.title: The Cathedral in Freefall
rows.strength: The stained-glass and architectural framing distinguish the cathedral strongly.
rows.remaining_deficit: Foreground platforms remain thin relative to the monumental background; moving joints need richer authored expression.

rows.title: The Weight of Everyone
rows.strength: The corrected four-unit falling mass reads as interlocking heads and grasping arms; its true collision footprint is unchanged.
rows.remaining_deficit: Crowd compression and physical release still need more carefully authored action poses. No still-image grade certifies its feel.

rows.title: Choir of Iron Halos
rows.strength: Metal mounts, ivy-free ivory surfaces and polarity state are clear across the course.
rows.remaining_deficit: Coil labels and repeated shrine furniture are not yet the rich mechanical architecture of the supplied target.

rows.title: Noon Without Shadows
rows.strength: Cast-shadow areas and dark/light boundaries remain visible through the different viewpoints.
rows.remaining_deficit: Shadow, scenic recess and decorative darkness can still merge; readable depth needs more authored separation.

rows.title: Scripture That Writes Back
rows.strength: Illuminated pages, real Ink state and lettered supports distinguish this level from the others.
rows.remaining_deficit: Words remain book-shaped platforms rather than a deeply expressive physical typographic world.

rows.title: The White Gate Is Below You
rows.strength: The mixed possession route retains all physical/material distinctions in the broad unseen views.
rows.remaining_deficit: The long vertical spaces and repeated shrines remain far less dense and individually authored than the concept.

rows.title: The Host of Hosts
rows.strength: The final face, tongue and radial tendrils have a coherent new authored family shared by the real body and distant apparition.
rows.remaining_deficit: The apparition is not the combat body. Actual final-act footage and stronger arena composition are still needed for the high bar.
